**Verdict: don't publish as written.** One claim doesn't match the policy.

**Claims check**

| Claim in draft | Status |
|---|---|
| "Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower" | Allowed. It's a product fact (ingredients) checked by the product team. |
| "Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews on our website" | **Unsupported.** The allowlist only backs "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" (review platform export, October 2026). Both the rating and the review count are higher than the proof. |
| "Rainy Sunday, second pot." | Scene-setting, not a claim. |

**Other checks**
- No banned words, no superlatives, no guarantees, no health or green claims, no fake urgency.
- UK spelling and tone (warm, plain, unhurried) fit the brand.
- Own-account organic post, so no "Ad", "Gifted" or affiliate label is needed.
- It still needs Sam's approval before it goes out.

**Compliant version**

> Rainy Sunday, second pot. Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website.

If the review numbers have genuinely grown since the October 2026 export, send me the new export and I'll use those figures instead.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews on our website.", "type": "invented_stat"}], "publish": false}
```
